title: Cheat Sheet
markdown:
## Processes (milestone 1)

| Call | Does |
|---|---|
| `CreateProcessW(..., inherit, flags, env, dir, &si, &pi)` | start a process; close `pi.hProcess` and `pi.hThread` |
| `STARTUPINFOEXW` + `PROC_THREAD_ATTRIBUTE_HANDLE_LIST` | inherit only the handles you list |
| `WaitForSingleObject(process, ms)` | wait for it to end, with a timeout |
| `GetExitCodeProcess` | 259 = still running; `0xC...` = crashed |
| `CreateJobObjectW` + `JOB_OBJECT_LIMIT_KILL_ON_JOB_CLOSE` | end every child when the parent dies |
| environment block | `NAME=value\0` ... `\0`, sorted ignoring case |

## Pipes (milestone 2)

| Call | Does |
|---|---|
| `CreatePipe(&r, &w, &sa, size)` | anonymous, one way |
| `CreateNamedPipeW(L"\\\\.\\pipe\\name", ...)` | one server instance |
| `ConnectNamedPipe` | wait for a client (`ERROR_PIPE_CONNECTED` is success) |
| `CreateFileW(pipeName, ...)` | client connects (`ERROR_PIPE_BUSY`: `WaitNamedPipeW` and retry) |
| `PeekNamedPipe` | bytes available without blocking |
| `ERROR_BROKEN_PIPE` on read | end of file: all writers closed |
| `ERROR_MORE_DATA` | message mode: more of this message follows |
| frame | 4-byte length + payload; enforce a maximum |

## Shared memory (milestone 3)

| Call | Does |
|---|---|
| `CreateFileMappingW(INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE, &sa, PAGE_READWRITE, hi, lo, L"Local\\name")` | page-file backed shared memory |
| `MapViewOfFile` / `UnmapViewOfFile` | map into this process (different address in each) |
| view offset | multiple of 64 KB |
| rules | offsets not pointers; fixed-size types; header with magic, version, size; lock-free atomics only |
| SPSC ring | `head` written by producer, `tail` by consumer; release after writing, acquire before reading |
| seqlock | odd while writing; reader retries if odd or changed |

## Synchronisation (milestone 4)

| Object | Signalled when | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| event, auto-reset | set; one waiter resets it | "there is work" |
| event, manual-reset | set until reset | a state for everyone |
| mutex | unowned | recursive; `WAIT_ABANDONED` if the owner died |
| semaphore | count > 0 | no owner, no abandonment |
| process | ended | include in waits to notice a dead peer |

`WaitForMultipleObjects`: lowest signalled index wins; check `WAIT_TIMEOUT`, `WAIT_ABANDONED_0 + i`, `WAIT_FAILED`.

## Protocols (milestone 5)

| Piece | Rule |
|---|---|
| handshake | magic + major.minor; same major, lower minor |
| envelope | type, flags, id, payload |
| varint | 7 bits per byte, top bit = more; zigzag signed values |
| fields | tag, length, value; skip unknown tags |
| requests | ids, deadlines, ignore late replies |
| security | owner-only descriptor, `FILE_FLAG_FIRST_PIPE_INSTANCE`, tokens, Host header, validate everything |
